description: Cross-system concordance map for compounds 5a-j, highlighting the 5f ex vivo / in vivo discordance
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

cmpds = ["5a","5b","5c","5d","5e","5f","5g","5h","5i","5j"]
ic50  = [np.nan,145,9,np.nan,np.nan,np.nan,np.nan,55,np.nan,289]
# 1 = active/reported effect, 0 = no effect, nan = not reported
binding = [0,1,1,0,0,0,0,1,0,1]
exvivo  = [0,0.5,1,0.5,0,1,0,1,0,1]     # 1 = sig at 30 min, 0.5 = weak at 60 min
invivo  = [0,1,1,0,0,0,np.nan,1,np.nan,1]

M = np.array([binding, exvivo, invivo], dtype=float)
labels = ["GABA$_A$R binding\n(rat brain, PDSP)",
          "Ex vivo relaxation\n(guinea pig trachea)",
          "In vivo sRaw reduction\n(A/J plethysmography)"]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2,1, figsize=(9.5,6.2), gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1,1.5]}, sharex=True)

ax = axes[0]
ax.bar(range(10), [v if not np.isnan(v) else 0 for v in ic50], color="#4C72B0")
for i,v in enumerate(ic50):
    if np.isnan(v):
        ax.text(i, 15, "no IC$_{50}$\nreported", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7, color="#888")
    else:
        ax.text(i, v+10, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("IC$_{50}$ (nM)")
ax.set_title("Compounds 5a-j: binding affinity and activity across the paper's three pharmacology systems\n(values from PMID 37418196 full text, sections 2.5, 2.9, 2.10)", fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0, 360)

ax = axes[1]
cmap = plt.cm.get_cmap("Blues")
im = ax.imshow(M, cmap=cmap, vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect="auto")
for i in range(3):
    for j in range(10):
        v = M[i,j]
        if np.isnan(v):
            ax.text(j,i,"n.r.", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8, color="#555")
            ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j-0.5,i-0.5),1,1, facecolor="#EEEEEE", edgecolor="white"))
            ax.text(j,i,"n.r.", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8, color="#555")
        else:
            ax.text(j,i, {0:"-",0.5:"weak",1:"+"}[v], ha="center", va="center",
                    fontsize=10, color="white" if v>0.6 else "#222")
ax.set_yticks(range(3)); ax.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(range(10)); ax.set_xticklabels(cmpds)
ax.set_xlabel("compound")
# mark the discordance
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((4.5,-0.5),1,3, fill=False, edgecolor="#C44E52", lw=2.2))
ax.text(5, 2.75, "5f: ex vivo active, in vivo inactive\n(authors' own discordance)",
        ha="center", va="top", fontsize=8, color="#C44E52")
ax.set_ylim(2.9,-0.6)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("Concordance binding vs in vivo: 8/8 compounds with in vivo data agree (Fisher p=0.029, kappa=1.00)")
print("Concordance ex vivo vs in vivo: 6/8 agree (Fisher p=0.49, kappa=0.50); discordant 5f and 5d")
